Download the `-setup.exe` file below and run it. It installs for your user account only, so it does not need administrator rights.

The installer is not signed yet. Windows shows "Windows protected your PC" the first time: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Every converter is included, so the app works without an internet connection. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lets you check the download.

See the [README](https://github.com/faiyaz-svg/convert-everything#readme) for what the app converts and its known limits.
